lyle.name: Salt Creek - Hothead Lyle
lyle.description: A Missouri bushwhacker turned gunman, about thirty-five. Rough, hoarse voice, thick backwoods accent, low and menacing when calm, ragged and loud when he shouts. Mean, mocking, unpredictable. Voice of a man on the 1880s American frontier, recorded close and dry like a film actor's dialogue, no music, no room echo. Unpolished and lived-in, not a modern announcer or narrator, not radio-smooth, no corporate or audiobook polish.

Voice of a man on the 1880s American frontier, recorded close and dry like a film actor's dialogue, no music, no room echo.
